string.text: Major Degtyarev. SBU. Sent to investigate the failure of Operation Fairway.
Stalkers helped me get to Pripyat.
Leave him, Captain. Let him go.
I have information for Kovalsky. Take me to him.
Follow me.
Alright. Follow me.
Weapons on the ground! Now!
Yeah... Quite a group.
Alright, screw it.
You! Stop!
Who are you? Why do you need the Colonel?
I knew it wasn't that simple.
Don't shoot! I'm Lieutenant Sokolov! Skat-4, second pilot! Heading to point B-28!
You know Kovalsky?

You think we're just walking around here for nothing, huh? Why the gun right away, my dear? Can't you see we're friendly, we're with a comrade... Eh, we've been through everything! It was a long road!
I don't care who works for whom.
And with the SBU too.
Without me.
I have no business with the military.
SBU? What the hell?!
Comrade Major, if you need anything, you should speak with the Colonel.
You probably need the Colonel, Comrade Major. Not me.
If anything, speak with Colonel Kovalsky.
You should talk to Kovalsky, Comrade Major.
Not to me, Comrade Major. You need Kovalsky.
Comrade Major, you... You should talk to Kovalsky.
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
Major, if it's not too much trouble - hide your weapon.
Listen, Major. Put your weapon away, we're not going to attack. An officer's word.
Major, be a human. Put that peashooter away to hell. Everyone's nerves are on edge here as it is.

We thank you for revealing to your servants the intrigues of our enemies. Illuminate with your radiance the souls of those who gave their lives to fulfill your will. Into battle, defenders of the Monolith! Into battle! Let us avenge our fallen brothers! May their eternal union with the Monolith be blessed! Death! A cruel death to those who reject its sacred power!
They'll spot you like that, Comrade Major.
All clear. Let's go.
We'll wait until they reach the center of the courtyard.
Target acquired.
They're leaving!
Don't be slow, they'll spot us any moment. Fire!
Ice, to the roof. Everyone else, follow me.
Everyone take positions.
Waiting for the attack order, Comrade Major.
Something's wrong. Is someone leaking our plans? Yes, we need to report to Kovalsky.
Ambush! Take cover!
Excellent shot, Comrade Major.
Let's check them. Ice, you cover.
Listen, those bastards knew about us.
Ice, did you fall asleep!?
Better ask the Captain.

Colonel, something strange is happening here. Inside the building, there was a crowd of Monolithians, as if in a trance. Staring at a pile of garbage and talking to it. I examined the garbage and discovered something interesting: it's some kind of antenna. It looks like someone is using it to communicate with the Monolithians. And they perceive these sessions as divine revelations.
This is all very strange. Someone is clearly controlling these fanatics. Alright, we'll discuss this later.
This is all very strange. Someone is clearly controlling these fanatics. Alright, we'll discuss this later. The sentry still hasn't shown up. If you find him, report immediately. Over and out.
Monolith, we cannot hear you.
Why have you abandoned us, Monolith?
We await your orders, Monolith.
Lieutenant Shelly, reporting for duty.
Holy crap, how many are there?
You know, I've been thinking. It seems safer with you.
Well, we're here.
Shoot them before they come to.
When I found out you needed help. I immediately volunteered, so come on, djigit. Lead the way.
The recon squad had data on a Monolith gathering point. The records mention a store called "Books".
The recon squad had records about Monolith surveillance. No large gatherings, only patrols.
I found the groups. They're all dead. Someone shot them, but no traces.

I can't understand. How did they manage to attack so suddenly? And with no traces. Strange. Major, we just pinged the sentry's signal. According to the coordinates, he's somewhere near the Gastronom store. Check it out, but don't be a hero. I'm counting on you, Major. Over and out.
Major, we need to find the recon squad. Find out what happened... Gh, some kind of madness. You, Major, be careful out there and keep in touch.
These fanatics, damn them. We need to deal with them.
These fanatics, damn them. And one thing after another: we have a missing sentry, no contact, and no traces. It's time we got to those bastards.
Alright, I'll send you two soldiers. They'll be waiting near the facility. Over and out.

Alright, I'll send you two soldiers. They'll be waiting near the facility. Also: we just pinged the sentry's signal. According to coordinates, he's somewhere near the Gastronom. If possible, check it out. In short, I'm counting on you, Major. Over and out.
Group, group, over. What's happening there?
I can't understand. How did they manage to attack so suddenly? And with no traces. Strange. I need to think about further actions, Major. Standing by.
Oh, the recon squad made contact.
No! What the hell? Stop! Stop, damn it! Ugh, motherfucker! Hey, someone get him off! N-no... Ghm, a!
Just imagine: reaching Pripyat without incidents. How did you even find that route? I can't figure it out.
Nothing complicated. You need skill and a bit of luck, and we got lucky. Or maybe the Zone rewarded us for patience. I've been hanging around the scientists for so long.
Yeah... Herman got on my nerves too.
The sentry is dead. He was acting erratically: he attacked me. A controller was found and destroyed near the location.
The sentry is dead. He was acting erratically: he attacked me. A controller was found near the location, I had to fall back.
The controller has been destroyed.

Copy that, Major. Looks like the controller took control of the guy's mind. A shame, he was a good soldier. And the recon squad probably suffered the same fate, they attacked each other because of that creature. Alright, thank you. Over and out.
Copy that, Major. Looks like the controller took control of the guy's mind. Damn, we need to do something about that bastard. While he's here, we're in serious danger.
Major, this is Kovalsky. We have another emergency. Come over, I'll give you the details.

Major, this is Kovalsky. We have another emergency. The sentry isn't answering calls. You know where the Gastronom store was? Well, his beacon signal is coming from there. Check it out if you can. Over and out.
Ah, Major. Well, come in, come in.
Get off me! Go away!
No! No! Nooo!
Tell the Colonel, I found one of your men. Looks like he blew himself up with a grenade. No signs of a firefight or other traces.

The radioman believes the signal is being jammed somewhere nearby. He's trying to pinpoint the coordinates. I sent soldiers to that area, but they went missing. Even their personal beacons can't be tracked.

Major, we're in deep shit. Since the helicopters went down, this hasn't been an operation. It's absurd. We're surrounded, no contact with the center. And there's no sign of improvement. We can't expect air evacuation. The helicopters didn't come again. And with these losses among the men, soon there'll be no one left to evacuate. Control is lost. We desperately need communication with the center.
One of your tasks, Major. Establish contact with the center. In our situation, I believe this becomes a top priority. And one personal request: find my soldiers. Deal?
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
I've approached the building, but all entrances are blocked.
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
Strelok and the personnel of the Skat group are killed. Prepare for takeoff.
That's it: Strelok is dead. Prepare for takeoff.
Major Degtyarev here. Communication is good.
So far, we've obtained documents about experiments in the Zone. Additionally, a stalker who has been to the Chernobyl NPP joined us. Call sign: Strelok. He's willing to cooperate.
Strelok claims that the helicopters hit anomalies. Their positions change after each emission, but this wasn't accounted for when creating the maps for Operation Fairway.

Yes. I've obtained reliable data, Strelok's information only confirms it. The helicopters were struck by anomalies whose positions changed during the emission. This wasn't accounted for when creating the map before the operation, which is why the landing force perished.
Get in the helicopter. I hope it was worth it.
Once we're in the helicopter, we'll talk, alright?
Plenty of time to talk. I have a bad feeling. Will we have enough ammo if something happens?
Well? Thank our dear laundry service, we ended up with a decent base. Now quickly to the helicopters and home.
Let's do it later, huh? This emission is making my jaw clench.
Another emission. Pfft, tired of it.
Damn, like being in a trench before a tank attack.
Huh? What? We're leaving!
It's here!
Yeah... And I used to think a downpour in the Carpathians was the end of the world.
Heh, now that would probably feel like sunbathing at a resort.
That was quite a shake. Maybe some smart person will invent a lightning rod for emissions.
Dreamer. He wants an "emission rod".
M-m-m, my head hurts so much every time during an emission.
So you're weather-sensitive.
What was that?
Commander! Zombies!
There are about a dozen zombies in that building.

this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
They made it, damn them. They actually made it. Strelok, you were right.
No time! Everyone check your weapons! Do not open fire without orders.
Major, a word.
Alright, the emission seems to have passed. Lieutenant, contact the center.
Major, we can't wait any longer.
Prepare for combat.
Well, one last push!
Squad, moving out.
Squad, fire at will. Forward!
Squad, move left. Cover each other.
Well, boys, did you get all that? Listen to my order: don't split up on the way, stay together, protect the stalker like the apple of your eye. Any questions? Good. Prepare for departure.
Go into the archway!
Everyone be on alert! Obey orders instantly and clearly. We're two steps away from the evacuation point. Let's go!
Damn, it's the Monolithians! Squad, don't spare ammo, free target selection. Continue advancing toward the helicopters.
Damn, Strelok is dead. If we want to live, we need to break through. Forward!
It's an emission, Comrade General. Communication is impossible during it.
Yes.
Copy that.
Major, where are you? We need to get Strelok to the point!
Major, we have to continue moving.
Major, we can't wait too long for you.
Well? Let's move on.
We're approaching!
Copy that, boys, we'll try to make it on time!
Now every zombie in Pripyat knows we're here. We need to move faster, squad, at a run.
Move out! Squad, to the right along the building, double time, march!
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
Comrade Major, we're under heavy fire. Can't identify the enemy, we won't last long!
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
Skat, we can't wait any longer, we're taking off in one minute.
Major, we're ready to take off.
Copy that.
To the choppers! Faster!
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
These creatures again, maybe we should go around the building?

Don't stop! Run!
More zombies ahead.
Let's run.
Not a bad shootout.
Press against the wall. These creatures pop out from all sides.
Take that, you beasts!
You thought you'd get me cheap?
What freaks!
A famous stalker. You're the one who turned off the Scorcher, right?
I'll check it.
I don't see anyone.
An emission is starting!
Alright, I'll come in.
So it's underground.
At the first opportunity, we need to report this to the center.
I see.
We have trouble. Helicopters are crashing. For unknown reasons.
Got it.
Ha, no kidding. No, I've never heard anything like that. Wow, in a refrigerator.
And also, Garik left for the Yanov station. He asked me to tell you he'll be gone for a few days.
Also, Vano asked me to tell you he left with Garik to Yanov. He said he'll come back with souvenirs.
Thanks for your help. The Colonel asked to see you.
Yes, sir, we have them, Comrade Colonel. But the signal disappears periodically, and its source is moving.
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
Wow, that's something. Could he really be back? We thought that was it: we'd never see our doctor again.
Alright.
Yes, Comrade Colonel.
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
It appeared. Very close to you.
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
Comrade Colonel, a radio signal source has been detected not far from the base. The transmission is encrypted, we couldn't decrypt it quickly.
What refrigerator? Where did you even find a refrigerator?
So what actually happened?
What do you mean?
So? Where have you been?
We had a detailed map for flying past anomalies. The helicopters were packed with emission protection.
Until this cause is found, there will be no more helicopters. We'll have to go to the edge of the Zone on our own two feet.
Do you have the coordinates, Lieutenant?
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!
After the emission, I'll contact command immediately.

The chief of staff made contact. I reported the situation and passed on the collected information. There won't be any helicopters for now. They've suggested we hold our positions and wait for orders. There are observers from the SBU at the headquarters, so you'll be able to talk to your people.
Lieutenant, at the first opportunity, establish contact with the headquarters.
Let's go, we'll talk in the shelter.
Monolithians again.
Who are you?
So what now?
Hmm, I don't even know what to say.
Where did I find it, where did I find it. I'd like to see you find anything in that condition.
You won't believe it, in a refrigerator.
Yeah, there was something. We'll talk about it another time.

Strange. Strange that you haven't noticed yet. After emissions, the positions of anomalies usually change: some dissipate, but new ones appear. Your map was outdated even before it was recorded on disc.
The reason is very simple. In the air, especially closer to the center of the Zone, there are as many anomalies as on the ground.
That did happen... But the plan didn't work. I came to meet with your command. I have information that will help control and destroy the Zone.
this text has not been translated - TRANSLATE THIS SHIT!

Emissions don't happen one after another. If you can scan the area immediately after an emission and detect the positions of anomalies, the helicopters will have enough time before the next emission to evacuate everyone.
I am Strelok.
